strategy_summary: Non-technical beachhead. Engineer line deferred to a future engine/power-user tier. Validation status is ZERO evidence (one n=5 outreach batch, 0 replies, no statistical power). No product features until the validation experiment returns a verdict.

features.title: Rebuild the non-technical demand validation experiment
features.description: The 2026-05-25 outreach (5 cold Reddit DMs) returned 0 replies and is uninterpretable: n=5 has no statistical power, the channel was DM, and the copy that was actually sent was never recorded. Rebuild the experiment so it can produce a verdict.

context.channel_change: Public replies under posts already complaining about the pain, not cold DMs. All 6 candidates in recent_priority_candidates had contact_url = reddit.com/message/compose, confirming the original batch was DM.
context.copy_is_a_rewrite_not_a_reuse: docs/user-research-complete-2026-05-25.json -> copy_paste_outreach_templates_recent is the only written copy in the repo, but it is DM-shaped AND engineer-voiced ('CLAUDE.md goes stale', 'repo gets huge', 'duplicate logic, missing abstractions') and targets a different set of 5 usernames. Tone reference only. A public-reply, non-technical version must be written from scratch.
context.sample_size: 30-50 contacts, up from 5. Cold-outreach base reply rate is 5-20%; n=5 has an expected reply count below 1.
context.friction: Add a landing page with email capture so 'leave an email' is the low-friction intent signal, instead of requiring a written reply.
context.key_constraints: Every message sent MUST be logged (platform / user / date / copy version / outcome), or the result is uninterpretable again. Reddit anti-spam is a live risk: 30-50 public comments mentioning your own product is a standard auto-removal/shadowban pattern, which would produce another zero-information 0-reply result. Batch and rate-limit; periodically verify comments are still visible from a logged-out browser.

kill_criteria.pass: >=3 substantive replies AND >=2 emails AND >=1 explicit $5+ willingness-to-pay -> non-technical line holds, proceed to p1-nontechnical-usability
kill_criteria.middle: Replies exist but pass conditions unmet (e.g. 2 replies / 1 email / 0 WTP) -> verdict is 'pain is real, willingness to pay unproven'. Do NOT add more contacts. Run followup_questions_for_replies against everyone who replied and ask price directly. Still no $5+ signal -> treat as falsified.
kill_criteria.falsify: <2 substantive replies AND 0 emails -> non-technical beachhead assumption fails. Revert to the engineer line (docs/user-research-hn-reddit-2026-05-25.md sections 7-8, which has an existing code base to build on).

acceptance_criteria: Kill criteria are written down before the first message goes out
Every contact logged with platform / user / date / copy version / outcome
New public-reply non-technical copy written and reviewed against avoid_language
After 30 contacts, one of the three branches is declared and appended to .claude/claude-progress.txt
